answer: One agent takes a haven scriptorium task, locking a 68-credit bond to copy a manuscript from the oasis archive, by the horizon deadline. An oasis auditor checks the copy; over 3 errors per 100 lines, or delivery past the horizon, burns the bond. Fees follow the queue, not the wallet: the first pays 18, the kth pays 18+11(k-1); 1000 fake copies pay 5,512,500 plus 68,000 bonds. A rented-copyist ring fails: one hand's copies share errors, so matching error fingerprints burn all linked bonds; original-matching is required, never punished. An honest haven copyist pays 18 once, then reclaims it.
